exhibitions_entry.name: Wilhelm Busch – German Museum of Caricature and Drawing
exhibitions_entry.description: Germany's national museum of caricature and the art of drawing, set in the Georgengarten landscape park in Hannover. Its holdings exceed 50,000 works and trace the history of caricature from around 1600 to the present, anchored by the complete oeuvre of Wilhelm Busch and the Ronald Searle Archive. The museum runs a zetcom eMuseumPlus online collection (Searle archive first), but the database server is currently unavailable.
